description: OpenCity Urban Data Portal is a data portal run by OpenCity (Indian civic data initiative). OpenCity is a portal that collects urban data sets of Indian cities and states, including transport, water, sanitation and budget data, for civic research. Coverage: India (cities and states). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, xlsx; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. It can support urban infrastructure studies of Indian cities. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
